given.part: An open loan's `dueOn` is before today
given.why: Two loans made on 2026-03-02 are due 2026-03-16, and the job runs with today set to 2026-03-17, so both loans are open and overdue.
The test clock is always 10:00Z, so no test runs near midnight, where UTC and local dates differ; code that used local time would still pass.

given.why: The only case set up is a loan with no reminders at all; no test has a loan reminded on an earlier day, so code that skips any loan ever reminded (for example `sent_on <= today`) would pass.
